QuestInfo.name: A Crack in the Dimensional Mirror
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra says that there is a crack in the Dimensional Mirror. You should check it out.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra says that sometimes the Dimensional Mirrors start acting up. Investigate the Dimensional Mirror.
QuestInfo.2: You found a crack in the Dimensional Mirror and ended up falling through! Now you're in a strangely familiar place...

0.0: The Dimensional Mirrors have been acting up lately. I think some of them cracked after the last earthquake, and now they're sending people to the wrong places. Would you mind checking it out for me?

yes.0: Thanks! Just see if there are any cracks in the Dimensional Mirror interface.

no.0: Maplers keep complaining about being sent to the wrong place. What to do...

default.0: Haven't you looked yet? Check out the Dimensional Mirror and see if there are any cracks in the interface.
